resources.string: Compare a revision with saved head

Read-only local editing comparison, from the chosen retained revision to this saved head. Pending form edits are excluded. Values are opaque editing inputs, not verified facts. No evaluation, price, report, evidence or cross-build equivalence is inferred.
Page %1$d of %2$d · changed fields %3$d–%4$d of %5$d. Open a field to inspect complete stored keys and values. Long previews are explicitly truncated.
Historical guest title/sample metadata is unavailable; no fields are reconstructed.
Retained metadata differs. Only supported guest fields are detailed here; other metadata values are not displayed.
The saved draft changed while preparing this view. Open history again to compare its current saved head.
Preparing local revision %1$s → %2$s. Closing this view cancels the inspection.
No supported local fields changed. The metadata and historical availability statements above still apply.
Inspect the complete stored key or a before/after value in ordered literal parts. This does not apply the change.
This field has no component or setting key.
Value part %1$d of %2$d · code units %3$d–%4$d of %5$d

Every part is complete. Parts preserve the stored UTF16 code units in order; quotes, controls and surrogate code units are escaped. Text and URLs remain opaque local inputs. No historical evidence, price or evaluation is reconstructed.
